applicationProcess.process_md:
> **Registration Process:**

**Step 1:** Visit the official website: [www.digitalgujarat.gov.in](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/)
**Step 2:** Click on the “Register” button on the homepage.
**Step 3:** You will be redirected to the registration form page.
**Step 4:** Fill in the required details such as: Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, etc.
**Step 5:** Submit the registration form to create your account.
> **Log In Process:**

**Step 1:** Go to [www.digitalgujarat.gov.in](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/)
**Step 2:** Click on the “Login” button.
**Step 3:** Select the suitable login option (e.g., Citizen Login).
**Step 4:** You will be redirected to the login form page.
**Step 5:** Enter your registered Email ID/Mobile Number and Password.
**Step 6:** Click Login to access your account.
> **Apply for a New Service:**

**Step 1:** Log in to the portal using your registered credentials.
**Step 2:** After login, your user profile will appear showing all previously taken services.
**Step 3:** Click on “Request a New Service” or the relevant option.
**Step 4:** You will be redirected to a list of services.
**Step 5:** Select the desired service from the list.
**Step 6:** Click “Continue to Service”.
**Step 7:** A form will open—fill in all the required information.
**Step 8:** (Optional) Click to auto-fill details from your profile.
**Step 9:** Click “Next” after completing each section.
**Step 10:** Upload/attach the necessary documents or import them via DigiLocker.
**Step 11:** Review all information and click “Submit” to complete the application.
> **Contact Us:** [Click here.](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/SchemPortal/ContactUs.aspx)

basicDetails.schemeName: Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Economically Backward Class Girls studying in Class 9

children.text: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat.
The applicant must be a female student.
The applicant must be studying in Class 9.
The applicant must be enrolled in a government or grant-in-aided school in Gujarat.
The applicant must belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS).
The applicant's family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000 per annum.

children.text: Free bicycle provided to each eligible girl student.

schemeContent.benefits_md: - Free bicycle provided to each eligible girl student.
schemeContent.briefDescription: Under this scheme, free bicycle assistance is provided to economically backward class girls studying in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aid schools across Gujarat.

children.text: The "Saraswati Sadhana Yojana to Economically Backward Class Girls studying in Class 9"  is a welfare scheme by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department of Gujarat. The scheme offers free bicycles to girls enrolled in Class 9 in government and grant-in-aided schools, facilitating easier access to education and encouraging regular school attendance. This physical aid helps in improving educational participation and empowering female students from economically weaker backgrounds.
